body:
In my lifetime I have tried a total of three types of prescription medications in the search for that high. Vicodin being the best, Oxcontin a close to but not as good as Vicodin second, and lastly Flexeril/Cyclobenzaprine.
I have tried Flexeril on five different occasions and at varying dosages. Starting out dosage of 5mg had zero effect. The last time I popped some down the dosage was 30mg. Even at 30mg, Flexeril leaves me feeling a tiny bit tingly and puts me in a VERY deep sleep...thats it.
After all the drugs I have tried keep coming back to weed as my favorite.
